analysisFile.description: path the analysis was actually written to

verdict.description: undecidable when the requirement is too vague to check against code — that is a finding about the document

confidence.description: how sure you are of the verdict, not how severe it is

evidence.description: The code that implements, contradicts, or partially covers the requirement.

role.description: what this line does for the requirement

searched.description: Where you looked, and what you found. An absent verdict rests entirely on this: a reader must be able to tell a real absence from a search that stopped early.

result.description: e.g. "3 hits, all in tests" or "0 hits"

reasoning.description: why this verdict and not the adjacent one

documentProblem.description: Set if the requirement itself is ambiguous, self-contradictory, or contradicts another document.
